key_insight: A loss-aware CNN decoder makes qubit-loss decoding tractable and shows that loss-dominated noise can substantially outperform Pauli noise in a high-rate qLDPC code.
engineering_relevance: Loss-resolving measurements paired with fast decoding could reduce fault-tolerance overhead in quantum hardware where qubit loss dominates.
method: Train a loss-aware convolutional neural-network decoder.
Generate Pauli-and-loss training samples with the high-throughput slim sampler.
Evaluate surface-code decoding and a walking syndrome-extraction circuit for the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle code.
evidence_signal: The CNN matches most-likely-error decoder accuracy on the surface code at much lower latency; for the [[144,12,12]] code at physical error rates below 1%, pure loss yields over 1,000-fold lower logical error rates than pure Pauli noise.
watch_item: The largest reported gain compares idealized pure-noise models; practical benefits depend on mixed-noise behavior and reliable loss-resolving measurements.
paper_title: Neural Network Decoders For Qubit Loss
